name: dynamic-web-architect
description: Deterministic web architecture decision engine, scaffolding generator, dynamic file router (place-file), shared-coupling promoter (promote), DAG boundary linter (audit), and structural sync for web projects.

defaultPrompt: /dynamic-web-architect init Design and scaffold the optimal architecture for a SaaS web app with Next.js App Router and TypeScript.
/dynamic-web-architect place-file Decide the canonical path, naming, and exports for a new component or service in this repo.
/dynamic-web-architect audit Audit DAG import boundaries, naming conventions, barrel discipline, and loose-file density in this project.
interface.longDescription: Dynamic Web Architect (DWA) is a deterministic architectural decision engine and dynamic filesystem governor for web projects across their full lifecycle. It classifies projects across 6 canonical architectural patterns (Classic by Type, Atomic Design, Feature-Driven + Screaming Architecture with Routing Shell, Hexagonal/Clean, Modular Monolith Fullstack, and Monorepo Workspaces), enforces naming and controlled barrel conventions, dynamically routes new files (place-file), promotes cross-module coupled assets safely to shared/core (promote), audits DAG boundaries, circular dependencies, loose-file density, and AI/server client leakage (audit), reconciles architecture-manifest.json and ARCHITECTURE.md (sync), and evaluates evolutionary transitions with a Transition Cost Guardrail (migrate).
